meta.description: Generate QA Contract with numbered Gherkin scenarios (G#N) and acceptance criteria (AC#N)

copy.tagline: 生成带编号的Gherkin场景和验收标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为QA团队生成结构化的测试场景和验收标准
copy.tagline_en: Generate numbered Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate structured test scenarios and acceptance criteria for QA

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会生成一份QA合同，包含编号的Gherkin场景（G#N）用于后端/数据，以及编号的验收标准（AC#N）用于前端。这些内容被规划模式引用并由qa-commit技能验证。
howto.when: 在Ask模式的Phase 2（CONVERGE）阶段，用于任何特性工作；或在实现前需要定义可测试的验收标准时触发。

say.text: 请为这个新功能编写QA合同，包括Gherkin场景和验收标准。
生成所有数据源的Gherkin场景。
say.note: Claude会列出每个数据源的测试场景。

say.text: 列出前端组件的验收标准。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates a QA Contract with numbered Gherkin scenarios (G#N) for backend/data and numbered acceptance criteria (AC#N) for frontend. These are referenced by Plan Mode and verified by qa-commit skill.
howto.when_en: During Ask mode Phase 2 (CONVERGE) for any feature work, or before implementation to define testable acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Write a QA Contract for this new feature, including Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria.
Generate Gherkin scenarios for all data sources.
say_en.note: Claude lists test scenarios per data source.

say_en.text: List acceptance criteria for the frontend components.
